title: 5 things about extern closing dates (v2.2, rotating photos)

brief.problem: Students treat a listed closing date as guaranteed time to apply; some Ontario postings came down before it, and talent pools look like open jobs.
hooks: 5 things every ontario nursing student should know about extern closing dates
your extern posting might disappear before its closing date
nursing students, don't wait for the closing date
brief.why: Growth Ops brief v2.1 (2026-11-20): cheat-sheet format modelled on recurring nursing slideshow accounts; number + audience + payoff. Every item is backed by a capture of the hospital's own posting page, re-checked 2026-11-20.
brief.payoff: Two real Ontario postings that came down before their listed dates, what a talent pool is, where to find postings, and to apply early.
evidence: ~/AgentHandoff/briefs/ontario-extern-tracker/2026-11-20-brief-v2.2-pinterest.md (owner limited Pinterest use to images with no identifiable person, badges, logos or paperwork: p2, p4)

slides.title: 5 things every ontario nursing student should know about extern closing dates
slides.body: incl. a talent pool closing nov 30

slides.title: 1. closing dates aren't a promise
slides.body: north york general's posting listed nov 16, but was “no longer available” by nov 12.

slides.title: 2. it's not a one-off
slides.body: southlake's extern posting listed nov 30. its page was gone by nov 14.

slides.title: 3. a talent pool isn't an open job
slides.body: shn's extern talent pool closes nov 30 (as posted). it's a candidate pool for upcoming vacancies.

slides.title: 4. stop checking hospital sites one by one
slides.body: the free tracker behind this account, ontarioexterns.ca, lists ontario extern postings + closing dates in one place.

slides.title: 5. apply the week you find it
slides.body: if you qualify, don't wait for the closing date.

caption.text:
5 things every ontario nursing student should know about extern closing dates 👇

closing dates aren’t a promise: north york general’s clinical extern posting listed nov 16 but its page said “no longer available” by nov 12, and southlake’s listed nov 30 but its page was gone by nov 14 (both rechecked nov 20). scarborough health network’s clinical nurse extern posting is a talent pool for upcoming vacancies, not a specific open job, and closes nov 30 (as posted, checked nov 20).

have you ever had a posting disappear on you?

ontario extern postings + closing dates: ontarioexterns.ca

ontarioexterns.ca is an independent tracker of Ontario extern postings, checked on hospitals’ own career pages. Not affiliated with any hospital or Ontario Health.
